item.title: October Update: iCube and iFly on TestFlight, Provenance 3.4, and a Virtual Jaguar Desktop App
item.description:
October Update

The last post here was the skin catalog in March. Since then 3.3.0 went out (2026-03-14: iCloud sync, the new tvOS UI, video filters) without a post of its own, develop has moved 1,490 commits past 3.3.1, and iCube, iFly and Virtual Jaguar each picked up a new way to install. This is a catch-up on all four.

item.title: Development Preview: Cheats, Controllers & Netplay
item.description:
Development Preview: What’s Coming Next

A lot has been happening in the develop branch lately. None of this is in the App Store yet — these features are still being polished — but we wanted to share what’s in the pipeline so you know where the project is heading. No release date promises here, just an honest look at the work in progress.
